header: See the till you'd buy in 30 minutes
lead: Send us three of your own articles beforehand. In the demo, you'll see your own prices on the till, not sample data.
note: The demo is run by someone who installs tills, not by a salesperson. We only record it if you ask.

agenda.title: 10 minutes of selling
agenda.text: Receipts, voids, card payments and refunds: the steps your counter staff repeat many times a day.

agenda.title: 10 minutes of figures
agenda.text: Cashing up, article groups and what a branch loses on a slow Tuesday afternoon.

agenda.title: 5 minutes of setup
agenda.text: How to import your article list from your old till, and where that often goes wrong.

agenda.title: 5 minutes of questions
agenda.text: Usually the part that decides whether the till suits you.
